entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3600975145895223040: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2828 +/- 0.0298 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 159.16 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -25.092, -12.358 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.374 +/- 0.089 solar radii from Kruse et al. 2019, the stellar radius of EPIC 201238110 b's parameter set from Kruse et al. 2019 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019ApJS..244...11K/abstract). Mass 0.41 +/- 0.112 solar masses from Heller et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of EPIC 201238110 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019A&A...627A..66H/abstract). Temperature 3587 +/- 157 K from Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 35019000 (VizieR IV/39/tic82); no NASA Exoplanet Archive row gives one.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,587 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc990. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,587 K and log g 4.91 (u1 0.374, u2 0.386): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
